scope_outcomes.criterion: A source qualifies when its text states a date, identifies a bounded excerpt or citation to Weber, or supplies an authoritative citation-count record relevant to locating the reader among the supplied Weber readers.
scope_outcomes.basis: The article states its submission, revision, acceptance, and publication dates; cites identifiable Weber works and page ranges; and contains a specific quotation attributed to Weber. The supplied metadata provides no scholarly citation-count record.
limitations: Complete coverage refers to the supplied article and metadata, not to Riley’s complete work or Weber’s entire reception.
No most-cited ranking can be made because scholarly citation counts are absent.
The article’s Weber citations include multiple editions and translations, and the supplied material does not establish full edition equivalence.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: Findings lost anchor evidence; this does not establish absence
One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
